data.body:
OPERATOR DECISION (human, in session): option (a) — accept AC5 as amended. The operator was presented with three options after the completion verifier twice refused this close: (a) accept the amended AC5, (b) revert the overlay as redundant with the blocking built-ins G1G2/G6/E4, (c) keep the ticket open for a non-overlay mechanism to deliver the method coaching. They chose (a).

AC5 has accordingly been rewritten in the description to state what the seven-run investigation actually establishes, with the original wording and the reason it is unachievable recorded inline: the overlay controls move APPLICABILITY (proven deterministically in tests/unit/test_project_symbol_reference_completeness.py), while the coach LLM controls SELECTION and no available plan shape can force it. The amendment narrows the claim; it does not widen it, and the unmet part is documented rather than dropped.

Known limitation carried forward, deliberately and on the record: this criterion's DETECTION half is largely redundant with rebar's shipped built-ins, and its distinctive METHOD coaching (re-derive with find_referencing_symbols, then grep the name as a string) cannot reliably reach an agent through coach selection. Full run log and reasoning: docs/serena-symbol-reference-coaching-sample.md. Change 1024 is MERGED.
